prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an opaque material atlas for a hand-painted cartoon dungeon floor.
Input image 1 is the original game mockup: study the quiet SMOOTH floor surfaces behind characters and objects, ignoring its stone edges, objects, torches, and UI. Input image 2 is the previous stone-material atlas: use its dark desaturated slate-blue palette ONLY. The previous atlas is far too faceted, chipped and busy for a walkable floor; do NOT reproduce its diagonal facets or damage.
Create ONE WIDE 2:1 image containing exactly EIGHT equal square material samples in four columns and two rows, edge-to-edge, with no margins, no dividers and no labels. Each square is a full-bleed flat stone SURFACE sample, not a tile with a frame or bevel. No brick seams or grout lines inside the samples. This will be applied to fixed game geometry later.
The user requests smoother quieter floor paving so characters, furniture, loot and traps are easy to distinguish. Each sample should read as an almost-flat matte dark blue stone field at game size, with just faint broad soft painted tonal wear. All eight share nearly identical average color/value, without checkerboard contrast. Variations are in very subtle cloudy worn patches and softly blended brush tones, not in damage. Keep overall color close to the lower half of input 2, with surface tonal variation reduced to roughly one quarter. Softly painted, velvety matte, flat and calm, not polished reflective stone.
Eight subtle independent arrangements: very faint clouded tone, a nearly invisible broad rubbed area, a soft asymmetrical smoothed patch, quiet blended stone, barely visible diffuse wear, soft patch at a different position, nearly intact stone, and another gently cloudy surface. Each must remain low contrast and visually subordinate to foreground objects. Preserve a crafted game-painted feel through broad blended shapes, no photographic granularity and no sterile hard vector gradients.
STRICT AVOID: no cracks, chips, pits, holes, cuts, gouges, sharp polygon facets, diagonal stripes, marbling, veins, small speckles, raised relief, light outlines, glow, purple energy, symbols, objects, text, stone-block borders, bevels, perspective or cast shadows. No bright highlights. Consistent restrained ambient lighting; do not put a strong directional gradient in each square. This is an opaque eight-sample material sheet, not the game scene.
userFeedback: Floor should be smoother like the mockup so placed objects remain easy to distinguish.
layout: 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 full-bleed surface samples
geometry: Accepted C floor unchanged; existing offline composition.
